articles.title: Dem nominee on being shoved to ground by NYPD during anti-ice protest
articles.titleZh: 在反冰抗议期间被纽约警察局推倒在地的民主党候选人
articles.summary: Darializa Avila Chevalier, a Democratic socialist who beat a four-term incumbent to win the Democratic nomination for New York's 13th congressional district -- where an ICE shooting took place this week, says she was pushed to the ground by a New York City police officer at an anti-ICE protest. Chevalier tells Erin Burnett, "I have been arrested 3 times in protests and not once have I been slammed to the ground by a police officer."

articles.title: Bill Maher & Fareed talk Trump, 'wokeness', midterms & more
articles.titleZh: Bill Maher和Fareed谈论特朗普、“觉醒”、期中考试等
articles.summary:
Fareed sits down with the ever-opinionated comedian Bill Maher, who aims his political arrows at both the right and the left, to discuss the upcoming midterm elections, "wokeness", President Trump's attacks on him, and more.

0:00 Bill Maher on the midterm elections & the voters' message to Trump
3:09 Is Trump losing his touch?
5:20 Will Democrats misinterpret the 2026 election results?
7:38 Maher on his relationship with the President
9:45 Has America reached Peak Trump?

Watch 24/7 live news with CNN Headlines: https://bit.ly/4eIvlTr

#BillMaher #FareedZakaria #News

articles.title: Torrential Rain, Intense Winds Pummel Gulf Coast as Hurricane Isaias Closes In
articles.titleZh: 飓风伊萨亚斯逼近，墨西哥湾沿岸遭遇暴雨、狂风袭击
articles.summary:
We are tracking Hurricane Isaias, the larger-than-expected, fast-moving storm which has already begun coming ashore along the coastal Florida panhandle and Alabama Gulf coast. Plus, the latest in the wake of an ICE shooting in New York that wounded a man, with a five-year-old in the car with him.


 


Learn more about your ad choices. Visit podcastchoices.com/adchoices (https://podcastchoices.com/adchoices)
